ns2:section.sectionText: The course focuses on food branding in Italy and globally. Its purpose is to advance students' understanding of one of the world's most successful ethnic food branding cases within the context of the globalization of food markets. Throughout the course students will study branding and advertising strategies, food cultures, markets and media in the U.S. and Italy to learn key principles in food marketing in the two continents. The course includes travel to Rome for 10 days in May. Students must apply for and be accepted to the course. Applications: http://app.studyabroad.illinois.edu/?go=ADVrome
